receipt: Atlas self-development laboratory now supports verified consecutive cycles without manual base reset. In a zero-spend controlled Git fixture, cycle 1 ran the candidate contract 3 times, promoted successfully, ran 3 post-promotion probes, and refreshed base identity/digests from the new clean HEAD. Cycle 2 started from that refreshed HEAD, again passed 3 isolated contract runs, then failed its 3 post-promotion probes as predicted-error evidence and automatically rolled back by Git revert to the prior good content with a clean repository. A stale manifest was rejected after HEAD changed, and promotion was explicitly rejected on a canonical main branch. No codec benchmark was used for this receipt; the next frontier is exercising the same loop on new real C candidates from Atlas.
